pages.title: Node Overview
pages.text: This page follows spatial_nodes_catalog.json. Cross-region travel is divided among fixed teleportation arrays, ancient rifts, sect gates, ascension gates, and Demon Realm rift events. The guide explains requirements, while actual travel follows available anchors, regions, and server validation.

pages.title: Mortal Realm Routes
pages.text: The catalog defines nodes for Yellow Maple Valley, Masked Moon Sect, Clear Void Sect, the Tiannan border, Mulan Grasslands, Wanbao Pavilion in Great Jin, and the Chaotic Star Sea hub. Common costs are spirit stones, sect permits, reputation, or travel credentials, gradually represented through tickets, contribution shops, and quest unlocks.

pages.title: Cross-Realm Requirements
pages.text: The Ascension Gate leads from the Mortal Realm to Tianyuan and requires peak Deity Transformation plus a successful tribulation. The Tianyuan-Fengyuan gate requires a border merit token and Void Refinement permission; the Nether River ferry requires yin stones and a ticket. Some anchors and guidance already exist for Tianyuan, Fengyuan, Yinming, and the Nether River pocket realms.

pages.title: Rift Hazards
pages.text: The Devilfall Valley rift, void fissures, and periodic Void Palace entrance are not stable transit points. Their risks include demonic corruption, random arrival, hidden visibility, scheduled openings, and compass tracking. Travel decisions remain server-authoritative; the client only requests and displays them.
